en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Umar Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a mother of the child, (can) she be sold regarding the debt.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, regarding a price of her slavery’.
